sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: First Aid is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Greetings. Here's the thing: you can see for yourself how far out in the wilderness I live. Things happen out here. Sometimes I find a good person clinging to life, and there's nothing I can do to help. I've had people breathe their last right in my arms. I want to put together a small medical kit, something with the essentials always close at hand. Will you help me?"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Find 4 items from the Medkits category Found In Raid
- Hand over the items
- Find 4 items from the Injury treatment category Found In Raid
- Hand over the items

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Jaeger Rep +0.1
- 80,000 Roubles
  - 84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Got it? Great. Hopefully, I won't have to watch people die helplessly anymore."

sections.heading: Medical Category
sections.text: For the Medical category you can hand over the following Found In Raid Items Salewa, Grizzly medical kit, AFAK tactical individual first aid kit, AI-2 medkit, IFAK individual first aid kit, Car first aid kit.

sections.heading: Injury treatment
sections.text: For the Injury category you can hand over the following Found In Raid Items Esmarch tourniquet, Immobilizing splint, Surv12 field surgical kit, CALOK-B hemostatic applicator, CMS surgical kit, Aseptic bandage, Golden Star balm, Vaseline balm, Army bandage, Tigzresq splint.
